structured_output.notes: All tests and smoke verification scripts strictly use the Python 3 standard library (unittest, urllib, sqlite3, tempfile, threading, http.client). Dynamic sys.path resolution is included at the top of each file to ensure modules can be imported seamlessly regardless of whether pytest/unittest is executed from the repository root or examples/minilinks. Server lifecycle routines ensure ephemeral port binding on port=0, non-blocking daemon threads, and clean shutdown on tearDown/finally.
structured_output.summary: Implemented comprehensive stdlib unit and integration test suites in test_api.py and test_persistence.py, along with the deterministic 12-step standalone smoke verification script in smoke_test.py adhering strictly to SPEC.md.
